metadata.relocation_note: 2026-08-20: gmuilj.org held the real journal as late as 2024-08 (wayback 20240811234803: 'Congratulations to the 2024-2025 Board... board for Volume 16'), then the domain lapsed. Antonin Scalia Law School's Publications & Journals page (law.gmu.edu/pubs) lists only GMLR, CRLJ, JLEP and NSLJ, and its HTML carries the comment ''. Only surviving presence is the submissions-only portal gmujicl.scholasticahq.com (no published content). No public archive found; back issues appear to be HeinOnline-only. Leave dead.
